description.zh: 以嵌套分支展示层级结构的可展开列表，每层节点可折叠或展开，子节点缩进排布于父节点之下。适合文件目录、组织架构、分类体系等天然成树的数据；节点可单选或多选，展开状态与选中状态相互独立。
description.en: An expandable list that shows hierarchy as nested branches: each node folds or opens and its children indent underneath. Fits file directories, org charts and taxonomies. Nodes may be single- or multi-select, and expanded state stays independent of selection.

use_when.zh: 数据天然分层，如目录、组织架构、分类树
use_when.en: Data is naturally hierarchical — directories, org charts, taxonomies

use_when.zh: 需要折叠分支以管理大量同级节点
use_when.en: Branches must fold to manage a large number of siblings

use_when.zh: 层级关系本身是信息的一部分
use_when.en: The nesting itself is part of the information

avoid_when.zh: 只有两层且每层几项，用 accordion 或分组列表
avoid_when.en: Two shallow levels with few items — accordion or grouped list is lighter

avoid_when.zh: 层级是导航框架而非内容，用 sidebar 或 menu
avoid_when.en: Hierarchy is site chrome rather than content — use a sidebar or menu

avoid_when.zh: 扁平长列表更适合，用 table 或 list
avoid_when.en: A flat long list serves better — use a table or list

note.zh: 同时只有一个节点被选中，常配合详情面板
note.en: One node selected at a time, often feeding a detail pane

note.zh: 可勾选多个节点，父节点支持半选态
note.en: Nodes checkable in batches, parents exposing an indeterminate state

note.zh: 带类型图标的目录树，最常见的产品形态
note.en: Directory tree with type icons — the familiar product form

task.zh: 展开与折叠若干分支，用方向键在节点间移动并选中一个深层节点。
task.en: Expand and collapse branches, move with arrow keys and select a deep node.

checks.zh: 展开状态与选中状态相互独立
checks.en: Expanded state and selected state are independent

checks.zh: 键盘可在父子与兄弟节点间连续移动
checks.en: Keyboard focus walks parents, children and siblings in order

note.zh: accordion 是并列分区的开合，tree-view 表达任意深度的父子层级
note.en: Accordion opens sibling sections; tree-view expresses parent-child nesting at any depth

note.zh: menu 用于命令与导航动作，tree-view 用于浏览并选择层级数据
note.en: Menu issues commands and navigation; tree-view browses and selects hierarchical data

disambiguation.zh: 「树」有时也指思维导图或组织架构图；本词条专指可展开、可选择的列表式树形控件。
disambiguation.en: Tree may also mean a mind map or org chart; this entry covers the expandable, selectable list control.

notes.zh: 子层级用递归缩进（padding-left 或 margin-left）表达深度，也可用竖向参考线辅助阅读。展开指示是小三角或加减号，旋转或切换图标表达状态；折叠时隐藏子树但保留 DOM 语义。键盘遵循 roving tabindex，方向键在可见节点间移动。
notes.en: Show depth with recursive indent (padding-left or margin-left), optionally with guide rules. The twisty is a small triangle or plus/minus that rotates or swaps with state; collapsed subtrees hide visually while keeping tree semantics. Use a roving tabindex and let arrows walk visible nodes.

basic.zh: 创建一个树形控件，展示可展开折叠的层级节点，并支持选中某个节点。
basic.en: Create a tree view of expandable hierarchical nodes with node selection.

design.zh: 设计树形控件。要求：子节点缩进对齐父节点；展开指示清晰且状态可辨；选中行有高亮；层级过深时缩进收敛；空分支有说明；深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Design a tree view. Requirements: children indent under parents; the twisty is legible across states; the selected row highlights; indent stays readable when nesting goes deep; empty branches explain themselves; consistent light and dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现树形控件：数据为嵌套节点数组，递归渲染 role="tree" / role="treeitem"；节点带 aria-expanded，容器 aria-multiselectable 视需求而定；roving tabindex + 方向键（上/下/左/右）控制焦点，Enter 或 Space 选中。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind tree view: render a nested node array recursively into role="tree" and role="treeitem"; nodes carry aria-expanded and the container takes aria-multiselectable as needed; a roving tabindex with arrow keys (up/down/left/right) drives focus and Enter or Space selects.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现树形控件（Tree View）组件。
先检查现有列表、折叠与 Design Token，优先复用缩进、图标与高亮样式。
用途：文件目录、组织架构、分类体系。
要求：
- 嵌套节点可展开折叠，展开态与选中态独立
- role=tree / treeitem，aria-expanded 正确标注
- 键盘可在节点间连续移动并选中
- 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion，深浅色一致
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a Tree View component in the current project.
Inspect existing lists, collapsibles and design tokens first and reuse indent, icon and highlight styles.
Usage: file directories, org charts and taxonomies.
Requirements:
- Nested nodes expand and collapse; expanded state is independent of selection
- role=tree / treeitem with correct aria-expanded
- Keyboard focus walks nodes continuously and can select
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion; consistent light and dark themes
- No new dependencies
Run the existing project checks when done and list the modified files.
